recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. The current core FHIR source already implements FHIR-17413; no follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes source.observer target profiles or Reference.identifier example guidance under a separate tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-17413 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested changing AuditEvent.source.identifier to AuditEvent.source.observer as a Reference, rather than leaving the AuditEvent source as only an Identifier.
initial_application: Git commit 6c0a0563b3ac6a188b713f2f1a04ff26229100cf explicitly cited GF#17413 and changed the AuditEvent spreadsheet from AuditEvent.source.identifier with type Identifier to AuditEvent.source.observer with type Reference(...). It also changed the AuditEvent source search parameter from a token expression on AuditEvent.source.identifier to a reference expression on AuditEvent.source.observer and renamed AuditEvent examples to use observer.
additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini and the current authoritative source is source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml. Later AuditEvent changes refined neighboring semantics: FHIR-32464 changed source.site to Reference(Location), and FHIR-32465 clarified source/observer prose from system/identifier language to actor language. A 2023 Security and Privacy Zulip thread confirmed that source.observer remains a Reference and may use Reference.identifier for logical references, so identifier-like example values do not reverse FHIR-17413.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build source has AuditEvent.source.observer as a required Reference with participant-style target profiles, the AuditEvent source search parameter is type reference over AuditEvent.source.observer, and targeted source searches found no active AuditEvent.source.identifier definition to fix.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue changed AuditEvent source identifier from string to Identifier, establishing the predecessor element that FHIR-17413 later replaced.
Later Published issue changed AuditEvent.source.site to Reference(Location), a neighboring source element but not a reversal of source.observer.
Later Published issue clarified source/observer actor wording after the Reference model was already in place.
